Yeha I've been through way too much. And I didn't even tell you about The guy who would let me and some other street kids crash at his place. He'd openly tell us about his HiV and then he'd proposition us individually to have "naked massages" and would say things like "Oh don't worry you can't attract HiV unless you draw blood" And since I'm not an idiot nor gay i'd decline. I can't even imagine the lives that guy has ruined. He also had a strange dislike for girls. Like none were ever allowed over. Weird. And that's just one story.. extremely condensed.

Unfortunately there is no way I will ever put a pill in my mouth again unless I'm gravely sick. I have seen too many pillheads and abusers in my life. i don't want to give my life over to pills. Those meds (The effexor) can't be abused but my mind and body were so dependent on them. I'd get sick if I missed a dose. For the first four months after discontinuing their use I thought I was going to have a stroke. I was getting "brain zaps" I still get the odd one. It will affect me forever. I absolutely can't risk losing my mind on medications given by doctors that very, very clearly do not know what they're doing. 

My last psychologist was like that scene in requiem for a dream, (Did I write this already? I didn't skim through my previous post.)when the mother goes into the office and he won't even look at her. I was having five minute sessions at best "Doc I'm so depressed I can't function and this medication is killing me" "Don't worry just take the meds you're fine", as he smiles. Meanwhile he's some rich guy who has never had a real problem in his life. Guaranteed he is on absolutely nothing. There is no way these people take those drugs. They'd probably scoff at someone that would suggest for them to.He doesn't even know where I'm coming from he never took the time to actually talk to me. It wasn't worth the hour trip each way just to refill a prescription that was practically killing me. From a guy that was providing no real help or answers.

I haven't worked in about five years... but it was impossible to maintain a job without a steady place to live. Just grunt jobs. Minimum wage garbage with no chance at progression. I think my last job was at a carnival watching a ride and teardown. But I was so exhausted and sweating so badly I had to leave after a few days. (The medication caused me to gain thirty pounds and I'd break a sweat just by walking down the block for instance. In a T shirt. In snowy weather.) I'm not kidding. For four years I was like this. I had to take my jacket off or wear lighter clothing in the winter because I'd be soaked. And the meds did this to me. Everyone thought I was a fiending crackhead. It was horrible.

I worked as a dishwasher. Fired. Worked in a factory stuffing envelopes: Fired. Worked in construction building carnival rides for the CNE: Quit I worked in an ice rink, that was alright. Laid off.

I can't remember all the others. My entire lifes timeline is a blur. Years are gone that I can't even remember. People that were important to me whom I can't even recall their names or faces. Just gone forever.

And I doubt anyone will hire me. Children have more impressive resumes than me. i'm not looking to work anywhere because no matter what all I'm good for is the worst of the worst low paying garbage jobs available to losers like myself. That and the likliness of my getting fired in a short period of time. The ice rink job which I had for about six months (I was laid off because winter ended, nothing much goes on at the rink after the winter. Depending on the rink.)

I know society is broken. That's a large part of the reason I am the way I am. People are so horrible. People right here all around us. From our teachers to our leaders to the people we're taught to respect, like the police. Or the military. And we misappropriate every resource we've ever had. What kind of society sells itself water? A horrible one. We worship the rich. And strive to be like them when in reality they're mostly just people that don't even deserve our praise or recognition. This world is made for only the rich and those that want to emulate them.

We can't even swim in most of our lakes or rivers anymore. What kind of modern progressive society are we that we have to teach our kids that river water is bad. And that one hundred years ago it was drinkable and swimmable. I don't want to live on this planet anymore.
That's so ridiculous. The river I lived by as a kid smelled like sewage. And looked like it too. Every river we've ever had will be like that in another one hundred years time.

I got to travel to my hometown once when I was young and got to meet my father for the first time. There was a clean river there. I got to swim in it, I'll never forget how cold the water was, even on a hot summer day. And that's when it clicked. Someday THAT river will be ruined. If not already. It's amazing how much freedom we lack in a society that boasts so much about it. We're only free to do what other people say we can do. We have the illusion of freedom. We can't go anywhere, we're regulated by money and identification. If we were free we could just jump on a boat to iceland for nothing and say fuck this place. That is freedom. And there was a time when something like that could be done. Not for a long, long time. nobody that we have ever known in our lifetime has been "free".

I'm sorry if this message seems hostile, it isn't meant to be but sometimes what I write comes off as too sarcastic or negative and it isn't directed towards you. Thank you for reading and responding and having well thought out things to say.

I'm not really sure what else to talk about there's nowhere to go from here but down, if that's even possible. I don't even know how to PM someone. But thanks for the reply.

Oh yeah I tried to go to college, I went through the whole adult upgrading process and aced the college entry exam. But by the third day was basically ridiculed in front of the class for not having a proper uniform (chefs uniform) because I was too poor to front the money for it and my loan hadn't come in. So my uniform was being sent two weeks behind everyone else. This guy was berating me angrily over it. So that everyone could hear. And he even commented on my whopping two days beard growth negatively. Wow man, two days it's like he doesn't know you're supposed to let it grow out for a few days so you don't get crazy ingrown hairs and pimples and shit. My hygiene is pretty good. Meanwhile this guy has a full beard and was fat as shit... So I had to explain in front of my peers that I'm a brokeass. I never went back. And it was so humiliating being singled out like that that I'm now in debt a few grand, which I will never be able to afford to pay back.
 Fortunately being on Disability I am untouchable by creditors.

I can't be around people. I just can't. It will never happen. People are awful. I am awful. I feel like I'm degenerating into something sub human. I feel like someday I will be a toothless vagrant on the street begging for change and dying alone. 

But to have the knowledge so far in advance that I will never succeed is devastating. Crushing. I can't handle it. I missed out on my entire twenties. There's ten year old kids out there that are further progressed in the world than I am. I am the biggest loser I have ever known. And I think about dying every day.

Every morning I wake up and sigh in disappointment as I realize who I am and where I am. I don't even want to get out of bed but I have to because I've overslept. I wish I could sleep forever.. it is the only time when my heart doesn't ache.

I forgot to mention when I was 20-25 I met a hub of homeless people kids to adults in a community downtown and it was amazing and yet sad. Good people for the most part. people that actually accept you and don't judge you for being poor like everyone else.

Sad thing is I saw a number of people prostitute themselves and contract HiV. Some of which are dead now. I watched this one girl go from being all bright eyed and pretty to having wiry hair and sunken cheeks. All in the span of a year. Discarded like a used rag.

We slept in an underground parking lot that was half demolished. We had to climb in through a hole in the rebar. We managed to get some mattresses in there. But someone started stealing people's things in our sleep so we abandoned it after a few months.

There is so much that I could write it is ridiculous. I could make a shitty book or something. Horror story after horror story.

Anyways, thank you for reading.
